create_datasets_synthetic: create synthetic classification datasets using make_moons, make_circles, and make_classification from sklearn.datasets
build_classifier_pipeline: build a scikit-learn pipeline with StandardScaler and a classifier using make_pipeline
test_classifier_accuracy: test multiple classifiers on synthetic datasets and report test accuracy scores
